## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pytest`, Ruff check, and Ruff format pass
- [ ] Bandit and the coverage threshold pass
- [ ] Documentation, translations, and changelog updated when applicable
- [ ] No credentials, identifiers, private addresses, captures, or proprietary files included
- [ ] Cloud failure does not break local video

## Compatibility

List the tested Home Assistant version and camera model, using no unique device
identifiers. Describe any behavior that could not be tested physically.
